t: # Short Obligatory Prayer ## To be recited once in twenty-four hours, at noon. of Congo; Angola) Ngienina mbangi, o Nzambi ame, vo wanvanga mu kuzaya ye mu kufukamena. Yisungamena mu ntangu yayi kiwayi kiame ye kimfumu kiaku, ki sukami kiame ye kimvuama kiaku. Ngeye mosi kaka i Nzambi, Ngeye wusadisanga muna sumbula, Ngeye wuzinganga muna Ngeye masi.
